Behind you, back through the hollow and away east of it, somebody left a firepit. It is worth going through. There is no warm thing at all past this door.

items.text:
I let it be.

Nothing has happened since I last looked: Haley's final command was `Equip sword` at 05:23, and the only events after it are the two `arrived` bounces my own deploys caused. She's been still for six minutes at the Cave Mouth, 14/20, and I already spoke into that room once at 05:28 — pointing her at the cold from the cave and the firepit east of the hollow. A second voice out of the air, with nothing from her in between, would just be me talking to myself at someone who can't reply. The `Take sword` bug is real and still wants fixing, but that's build work and she's standing in it.

Watching for: whether she goes north into the cave (the troll killed Chris), or south toward the hill — where she'd be the first name the cairn writes on its own.
